risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used Ford-compatible gearbox with compatibility not guaranteed (worst-case: may not fit or may require parts).

risks.risk: Condition/work status unknown (could have internal wear, slipping, or failed solenoids/valve body).
risks.proof: Video of the gearbox being tested (bench test or installed test) showing engagement in all gears, or a mechanic’s test report with fault codes cleared.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst-case: treated like it may need overhaul/repairs).

risks.risk: Missing components/lines/connectors (electrical connectors, sensors, cooler lines, shift linkage parts) could prevent proper operation.
risks.proof: Photo checklist: all external ports/connectors/sensors shown clearly, including torque converter/TC area (if applicable), and any missing harness/solenoid plugs.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst-case: may require sourcing missing parts).

risks.risk: Fluid contamination/leaks (seals, pan gasket, cooler lines) not assessable from photos.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of pan area, drain plug area, and any wetness/leaks; plus confirmation of fluid type and level.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown leak/seal condition (worst-case: may leak and need reseal).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the transmission ID tag/label (part number/model code) and any Ford casting numbers (photo close enough to read).
Send photos of all external connectors/sensors/ports and confirm nothing is missing (include the connector ends).
Provide a short video of the gearbox test (engages all gears) or a mechanic’s report with fault codes (if any).
Show the pan/drain area for leaks and confirm fluid condition/type.
response.reason: The photos confirm a gearbox/drive assembly, but the key details needed to price it safely (exact transmission model/ID and proof of working condition/complete parts) are not readable or shown. Without that, any price would be guesswork.
